model: unit-mass rectangular lattice with spacings (b,b,c,c,c), all common-radius contiguous blocks ell in {1,2,3,4}^5
not_previously_excluded: C has multiplicity pattern 1+4. This batch searches the distinct 2+3 stratum and the all-equal diagonal over [4/5,9/4]^2, reaching far beyond small C perturbations. Old common-tail local intervals and 1+3/2+2 tail splitting at fixed or almost-fixed first axis do not cover this model plane.
event_steps: Eight fixed seeds, then exactly four adaptive global coordinate-event steps. Starting from the best seed, alternate b,c,b,c. At each step scan all distinct floating raw endpoint event coordinates in [4/5,9/4] with the other coordinate fixed. Update only if the maximum improves the current floating value. Event representatives retain integer root-products, signs and half-integer slopes, allowing exact algebraic reconstruction. No additional seed, minimizer, grid or replacement is allowed.
event_lines: 0, a/2, root(prod ell)/2-(ell_j-1)*a/2, ell_j*a/2-root(prod ell)/2 for all 1024 length vectors and each possible ell_j; solve pair intersections within one axis
numerical_scope: float64 diagnostic only. No interpolation or numerical maximum is a proof or global exclusion.
exact_selection: Select at most two best distinct configurations among the eight seeds and four coordinate-step outputs. Reconstruct event coordinates from stored Q(u,v) line pairs, never from displayed decimal; rational seed coordinates remain rational. Exact ratio minus all 25 complete C coefficients must have positive lower bound to win.
guards: positive real lattice spacings; actual unit atoms; common cube radius; exact union by two engines; explicit finite collar and smooth L1 transfer applicability; no model improvement may be called C5 improvement without review
stop: Finish after eight seeds, four coordinate steps, and at most two exact certifications, or stop at a registered cap. No global claim from these finite operations. Do not commit.
